title: Elev8 Sea Mine
description:
The Elev8 Seam Mine is another beautifully artistic piece from elev8 glass. It features a small shower percolator at the bottom then sitting above is one of the most impressive swiss sea mine percolator. This thing is truly a work of art but is not just for show. The action on this rig is awesome.
The elev8 sea mine utilizes a 14mm female glass joint.
14mm Whip Adapter NOT Included
Included
1 x Elev8 Sea Mine (Choose Colour)
